title: Infestations catalog
description: Infestation events: a hostile faction takes over a location, and killing its mob and boss pays a reward.
x-help:
An Infestation takes over one site at a time. The map shows a dark fog over the area; walking into the fog reveals the exact site. Killing enough of the faction's mob summons a mutated legendary boss, and killing the boss pays out XP, caps and scrip.

Sites carry Fallout 76 world coordinates and are only read from SeventySix.esm, so adding your own sites does nothing. What a mod can add or change are the factions that take sites over (a mob list and a boss list each), the regions that can be toggled on or off, and the boss mutations.

The Settings tab holds the timing, the reward and the records used for messages and effects. They come from the conversion.

settings.description: Feature-wide values; a later plugin's field replaces the earlier one.

plugin.title: Plugin
plugin.description: Tales only supports infestations built for SeventySix.esm.

tuning.title: Timing and thresholds
tuning.description: How long an infestation lasts and when its stages trigger.

expire_seconds.title: Lasts (seconds)
expire_seconds.description: How long an infestation stays up before it expires.

marker_radius.title: Fog radius
marker_radius.description: Radius, in game units, of the dark fog on the map.

boss_kill_fraction.title: Boss appears after (fraction killed)
boss_kill_fraction.description: Share of the mob that must die before the boss appears, from 0 to 1.

remaining_fraction.title: Show remaining count after (fraction killed)
remaining_fraction.description: Share of the mob that must die before the HUD lists how many enemies remain, from 0 to 1.

forms.title: Records used by the event
forms.description: Quest, messages, toggle and boss effects.

quest.title: Event quest
quest.description: Quest that shows the Infestation objectives.

started_message.title: Started message
started_message.description: Message shown when an infestation begins.

ended_message.title: Cleared message
ended_message.description: Message shown when an infestation is cleared.

boss_message.title: Boss message
boss_message.description: Message shown when the boss appears.

announce_toggle.title: Announcements toggle
announce_toggle.description: Global that turns the announcement messages on or off.

boss_explosion.title: Boss spawn explosion
boss_explosion.description: Explosion played where the boss appears.

boss_roar.title: Boss roar
boss_roar.description: Sound played when the boss appears.

scrip_item.title: Scrip item
scrip_item.description: The item that stands for scrip.

toggle.title: Reward toggle
toggle.description: Global that turns the reward on or off.

boss_rank.title: Boss legendary rank
boss_rank.description: Stars of the legendary boss, from 1 to 5. Defaults to 4.

source.title: Source
source.description: Where the catalog was converted from. Informational.

fog_sha256.title: Fog bitmap hashes
fog_sha256.description: Fingerprints of the map fog bitmaps. Informational.

skipped.title: Skipped counts
skipped.description: How many source rows the converter skipped, by reason. Informational.

sites.title: Sites
sites.description: Locations that can be taken over. Read from SeventySix.esm only: they carry Fallout 76 world coordinates.

location.title: Location
location.description: The location that gets taken over.

region.title: Region
region.description: The region the site belongs to. A region can be switched off in the Regions tab.

world.title: Worldspace
world.description: The worldspace the site is in.

center.title: Centre (X, Y, Z)
center.description: World position of the site's centre, where the fog is centred.

marker.title: Map marker
marker.description: The reference that marks the site on the map.

clear.title: Mob spawn points
clear.description: References whose actors are replaced by the faction's mob. At least one.

boss.title: Boss spawn points
boss.description: References where the boss can appear. At least one.

factions.title: Factions
factions.description: The groups that can take a site over. Each has a mob list and a boss list.

key.title: Name
key.description: The faction's name, for example Scorched.

keyword.title: Faction keyword
keyword.description: Keyword that identifies the faction's actors. Optional.

mob.title: Mob list
mob.description: Leveled list of the ordinary enemies that fill the site.

boss.title: Boss list
boss.description: Leveled list the boss is chosen from.

regions.title: Regions
regions.description: Areas of the map that infestations can be switched on or off for, one toggle global each.

toggle.title: Toggle global
toggle.description: Global that is non-zero while infestations are allowed in this region.

mutations.title: Boss mutations
mutations.description: Spells or perks a boss can be given. One is chosen for each boss.

form.title: Mutation
form.description: The perk or spell applied to the boss.
